summary.en: Compute MAE, MSE, RMSE and R², compare a training-mean baseline and read structured residuals.
summary.bn: MAE, MSE, RMSE আর R² বের করো; গড়ের অনুমান আর residual-এর প্যাটার্ন মিলিয়ে দেখো।

notes: NumPy 2.0+, pandas 2.2+, scikit-learn 1.5+; round displayed values only.

sections.title: Which mistake matters to the family?
Compute MAE, MSE, RMSE and R²
Match hand calculations and library scores
Check units, ordering and reference values

examples.title: Calculate four metrics without a library
examples.explanationHtml: Four one-unit mistakes and one exact prediction give SSE 4, MSE 0.8 and R² 0.9 against SST 40.

examples.title: Check the metrics with scikit-learn
examples.explanationHtml: Taking the square root explicitly works across supported scikit-learn versions. R² is a relative squared-error score, not an accuracy percentage.

examples.title: Compare two study predictors on identical rows
examples.explanationHtml: The operational baseline always uses the training mean. The R² denominator uses the evaluation targets mean by definition; those are different roles.

practice.title: Report four scores with an undefined-R2 policy
practice.statementHtml: Read n (1–100), then n observed/predicted pairs. Print MAE MSE RMSE R2 to three decimals. If every target is identical, print undefined for R2.
hints: Guard the centred target sum, not the residual sum.

practice.title: Compare operational mean and evaluation mean
practice.statementHtml: Read n and n training targets on one line, then m and m test targets on one line; n,m are 1–100. Print the training mean and its test MAE to three decimals.
hints: The baseline must not learn from test answers.

practice.title: Construct negative R2
practice.statementHtml: Evaluation targets have SST=40 and predictions have SSE=100. Find R² and interpret the sign.
practice.answerHtml: R²=1-100/40=-1.5. The predictions have greater squared error than using the evaluation target mean as a retrospective reference. An actual baseline still learns its mean from training targets.

practice.title: Find a hidden pattern
practice.statementHtml: Two models have equal MAE, but one has positive residuals for every high-rent flat. What should the report add?
hints: An average can hide conditional error.
practice.answerHtml: Add a residual-versus-predicted or rent-band plot and relevant subgroup scores. Positive observed-minus-predicted residuals show underprediction in that band. Investigate representation or missing structure before deployment.

quiz.prompt: What is the MAE of the five pictured predictions?
quiz.explanation: Absolute residuals are 1,1,1,1,0. Their total 4 divided by 5 is 0.8.

caption.en: Target values and predictions in marks.

quiz.prompt: Which pictured predictor has negative R²?
quiz.explanation: SST is 40. The poor predictor has R²=1-100/40=-1.5.

caption.en: The mean reference uses five targets 2,4,6,8,10.

quiz.prompt: What is the RMSE unit for a rent target in monthly BDT?
quiz.explanation: The square root brings squared residual units back to target units.

quiz.prompt: Why inspect a residual plot after computing one MAE?
options: A single MAE proves all assumptions
Patterns can reveal curvature, changing spread or group-specific errors
quiz.explanation: Scores collapse many residuals into one number; their arrangement can still matter.

quiz.prompt: What does R²=0.9 mean in this nonconstant-target example?
options: SSE is 10 percent of the evaluation-mean reference SSE
90 percent of predictions are exactly correct
All errors are below one mark
The model caused 90 percent of marks
quiz.explanation: R² measures relative squared error, not classification accuracy or a causal share.

quiz.prompt: Which value should an operational mean baseline predict on the test set?
options: The test target mean chosen after reading answers
The test median under any mean baseline
A separate mean for each test target
quiz.explanation: The evaluation-set mean belongs in R² arithmetic, not in a deployable fitted baseline.

quiz.prompt: What caution applies when every evaluation target is identical?
options: The usual R² denominator is zero; explain any library convention
quiz.explanation: SST is zero for a constant target. sklearn may return finite replacement scores by default.

quiz.prompt: What RMSE follows MSE=9 in marks squared?
quiz.explanation: Taking the square root of nine gives three marks.

quiz.prompt: What R² follows SSE=100 and SST=40?
quiz.explanation: The model is worse than the evaluation-mean reference: 1-2.5=-1.5.

quiz.prompt: Which metric gives more influence to a single large residual?
quiz.explanation: MAE is 6/3=2 and MSE is 36/3=12. Compare units when interpreting their sizes.
quiz.code:
errors = [0, 0, 6]
mae = sum(abs(e) for e in errors)/3
mse = sum(e*e for e in errors)/3
print(f"{mae:.1f} {mse:.1f}")

keyPoints.en: MAE and RMSE share the target unit.
keyPoints.bn: MAE আর RMSE টার্গেটের এককেই থাকে।

keyPoints.en: R² compares squared error with an evaluation-set mean reference.
keyPoints.bn: R² ভুলের বর্গকে যাচাই ডেটার গড়ের reference-এর সঙ্গে মেলায়।
আগে না দেখা ডেটায় R² ঋণাত্মক হতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: Residual patterns reveal problems that one score can hide.
keyPoints.bn: একটা স্কোরে ধরা না পড়া সমস্যা residual-এর প্যাটার্নে দেখা যেতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: Compute four metrics for y=2,4,6,8,10 and predictions 3,3,7,7,10.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Residuals=-1,1,-1,1,0. Absolute sum=4 and SSE=4, so MAE=0.8 and MSE=0.8. RMSE=sqrt(0.8)=0.894. Target mean=6 and SST=40, so R²=1-4/40=0.9.

examQuestions.question: Interpret SSE=100 and SST=40, and discuss constant targets.
examQuestions.answerHtml: R²=1-100/40=-1.5, worse than the evaluation-mean reference. With constant targets SST=0, so the ordinary ratio is undefined; report any finite replacement convention explicitly.

examQuestions.question: Describe a residual audit beyond average MAE.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Plot observed-minus-predicted residuals against fitted values and relevant inputs. Look for curvature, changing spread and group-specific errors. Compare a training-mean baseline on identical rows and report units, data origin and coverage.
